# Current Together AI visual reference (2026-09-28)

Use the current Together AI public homepage, not an unrelated AI dashboard. White and mist-blue canvas; black wordmark and text; airy, almost full-width sections with large vertical white space. The first desktop viewport has a narrow black announcement bar, a floating white navigation strip, left-aligned large black/gray two-line hero heading, small description and black/gray rectangular CTAs. On the right place the brand's distinctive intersecting translucent blue discs, purple rings and orange hexagon 3D assembly with tiny mono technical labels. A muted partner-logo marquee sits along the lower hero edge. Typography resembles The Future / The Future Mono: geometric modern sans for body/headings and very small mono uppercase labels. Below: centered Together AI Platform heading and three pastel blue/pink/peach metric blocks; wide Full-stack cloud tabbed product showcase with cyan active tab; dark navy research-carousel chapter; customer case-study cards; recent articles; clean CTA and dense footer with huge pale together.ai wordmark. Mobile hides the desktop 3D hero art, centers stacked heading and CTAs, uses a compact white header with black SIGN IN and hamburger, and stacks content vertically. Avoid purple cyberpunk, dark SaaS hero, invented model cards or fictional claims.
